ModMetaData.name: Trader Hotline – Call the Orbital Trader You Want
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Call the orbital trader you want from the comms console – and it really comes.
- Pick any orbital trader (also from mods) and see what it usually sells. - Normal or express delivery; pay from any silver in your stores – no orbital beacons needed. - Countdown in the alerts. - If it can't come (game limits, other mods), it tries again for two days – otherwise your fee comes back. - A called trader stays longer. - Works with Trader Ships and other trader mods.
Safe to add to an existing save. Requires Harmony. English and Czech.
